name: Prompt Secret Guard
summary: Block prompts containing high-confidence credential formats before model processing.
description: A deterministic Claude Code UserPromptSubmit gate that suppresses the original prompt when it detects a bounded set of high-confidence private keys and live credential formats.
refuses: It does not reveal, store, transmit, rotate, or revoke a detected credential.
It does not inspect attachments, referenced files, prior turns, or model output.
It does not claim that its bounded high-confidence patterns replace a secret scanning service.
It does not provide a prompt-controlled allowlist or inline bypass marker.

entrypoints.purpose: Reject submitted prompts that contain high-confidence credential formats without echoing their contents.
